headline: GreenTree Hospitality Q3 Revenue Falls 22.2% to RMB 243 Million
summary: GreenTree Hospitality reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of RMB 243.0 million ($36.2 million), down 22.2% year-over-year. Net income dropped to RMB 49.3 million from RMB 59.0 million.
why: GreenTree Hospitality Group is a major franchised and managed hotel operator in China.

impacts.name: GreenTree Hospitality Group Ltd.
impacts.why: A 22.2% decline in quarterly revenues and lower net income directly depresses company equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Lower year-over-year revenue and net income figures weigh on investor demand for the company's shares.
